SEOUL, April 4, 2024 — Two new concept vehicles were showcased at Genesis House New York last week.

The GV80 Coupe Concept was among four vehicles from the Genesis Magma program that were on display at Genesis House New York on March 25. “With this vehicle, the mission was to infuse more adrenaline into the Genesis portfolio, increasing the emotions we feel while driving,” Genesis Chief Creative Officer Luc Donckerwolke told the crowd.
Donckerwolke, center, explains about the G80 Magma Special to global media, mentioning that it will be sold as a limited edition in the Middle East.

Donckerwolke clasps hands with SangYup Lee, left, Head of Genesis Global Design, as the latter steps forward to explain about the Neolun Concept, which was globally revealed for the first time this day.
B-pillarless coach doors, one of the most notable features of the Neolun Concept, create a spacious cabin that accentuates comfort and relaxation.
“Through Magma and the Neolun Concept, we are setting a new standard and starting a new chapter,” said Jay Chang, President and Chief Executive Officer of Hyundai Motor Company.

From left, Claudia Marquez, Chief Operating Officer of Genesis Motor North America; José Muñoz, President and Chief Executive Officer of Genesis Motor North America; Chang; Donckerwolke; Lee; and Mike Song, Global Head of Genesis.
Lee, Donckerwolke and Ickx talk about the future of Genesis during a panel discussion with global media.
